handbook.what: Changing what a class is called, for a name typed in a hurry or a group that has moved up a year.
handbook.where: The class page, the small pencil beside the class name.
how: Tap the pencil next to the name at the top.
handbook.note: Only the name changes. The roster, the join link, the join code and the class's place on the course all carry on exactly as they were.
